summary: Goat Hill fire tower in Oxford, MA: an early-1920s iron tower was lost in the 1938 hurricane; the 68-foot steel tower built in 1939 is fenced and posted no trespassing.

facts.design: 68-foot steel tower with a 10x10-foot wooden cab (NHLR)
facts.agency: Mass. Bureau of Forest Fire Control (NHLR); visitor guide names DCR State Parks Central Regional Office as manager

access.note: Fenced and posted with No Trespassing signs as of March 2019 (NHLR). The visitor guide says the tower was fenced and posted no trespassing as of its most recent published report, and that the surrounding forest is public DCR land.

visit.trail_note: Do not climb. The surrounding forest is open for hiking year-round (visitor guide).

events.note: First tower: 68-foot iron tower, built in the early 1920s (NHLR). 1920 stands in for 'early 1920s'; the exact year was not confirmed.
Destroyed by the Great New England Hurricane, September 21, 1938
Current 68-foot steel tower with a 10x10 wooden cab built to replace the one lost in 1938
Registered December 15, 2004 as US 620, MA 31; nominated by Henry Isenberg
Fenced and posted with No Trespassing signs as of March 2019 (NHLR)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register names the Mass. Bureau of Forest Fire Control as administrator; the visitor guide names DCR State Parks Central Regional Office as manager of the land. The story reports both and flags that the guide marks its details unconfirmed.
The Register says early 1920s and the visitor guide says 1920s; the easternuslookouts list gives no date for the first tower. The story keeps to early 1920s.

notes_for_editor: The FFLA Massachusetts Chapter Facebook post on this tower could not be fetched (login-blocked). A search snippet from it reportedly dates construction of the first tower to fall 1925; that snippet was not used as evidence. Roamful is a third-party guide that says its details are unconfirmed; it is used only for the DCR manager and the access line, and the access line repeats the 2019 Register report. No staffing information found. Access is as of March 2019 with no newer source.
